[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once created a '''red-bladed [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber shoto]] '''during the [[Nagai–Tof War]] to combat the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady]] [[Lumiya]] and [[Lumiya's lightwhip|her exotic]] [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]] on [[Kinooine]]. 

==History==
[[File:Battle_of_Gilatter_VIII.jpg|thumb|left|229x|Luke wields his shoto against Lumiya]]
The shoto was made from materials from an [[Iskalonian]] [[Stinger (weapon)|Stinger]], including its [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]].<ref name="DWaDL" /> Luke used the shoto when he practiced his saber training with three [[Marksman-H combat remote]]s before the [[Second Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Star Wars 100">[[Star Wars (1977) 100|''Star Wars'' (1977) 100]]</ref> 

During the [[Battle of Iskalon (Nagai–Tof War)|Battle of Iskalon]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando]] used the shoto while being underwater to bring down the Nagai's tower.<ref name="Star Wars 102">[[Star Wars (1977) 102|''Star Wars'' (1977) 102]]</ref> Luke also used his shoto during the [[Battle of Zeltros]].<ref name="Star Wars 104">[[Star Wars (1977) 104|''Star Wars'' (1977) 104]]</ref> 

Many [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, Luke would use it again to combat Lumiya during the [[Battle of Gilatter VIII]] while his twin sister, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] dueled [[Alema Rar]].<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>
